implementation: StreamsClient with caller-driven typed API88 v0 heartbeats, explicit opt-in, actual GROUP discovery and per-connection negotiation. Full terminal responses retain errors/assignments/status. Warm calls reuse one coordinator socket. Retries, encoding, auth/discovery and I/O share one deadline; no background membership tasks.

bounds.heartbeat_limits: StreamsLimits defaults:wire1MiB,strings64KiB each/1MiB aggregate,elements8192 each/32768 aggregate,tags64 each/1024 aggregate,payload64KiB,decoded requested4MiB

behavioral_tests: Actual coordinator capability and downgrade after reconnect
All typed fields/null-empty and terminal authorization/member/topology errors
Coordinator14/15/16 and lost socket refresh with identical request
One original stalled/delayed deadline and eight-attempt cap
Actual EOF/zero workers after cancel while client lives; same client works again
Warm four heartbeat calls use one GROUP lookup; socket close/group change force new discovery without implicit leave
closure: Each peer joins three listeners/workers, checks three closed/rebindable ports and zero runtime tasks. Cancellation/close also observe worker EOF before client destruction. No detached client tasks.
strict_checks: Latest-stable1.99 default/all Clippy -Dwarnings, rustfmt and rustdoc pass. Fifty-three coverage checker tests pass.
retained_failures: Initial helper compile rejected an unused owned AbortHandle; scoped visibility warnings corrected. Exact source/log retained.
External fixture copy result and four warm-test results violated strict unused-results. Exact failures and sources retained; assertions now consume responses and the redundant copy was removed.

An early wrapper attempted SDK startup after a failed compile and missing binary binding; it stopped before executing any SDK/public call. Final runner verifies bound source/binary and mandatory external lane before all execution.
Initial strict Clippy rejected ignored must-use cleanup results and dropping a Pin reference. Named cleanup outcomes and lexical future scope pass strict checks; EOF tests prove actual cancellation.

A subsequent strict check rejected fixture expect; the finite assertion uses the explicitly scoped unwrap policy. First failures and prior independently passing uncached histories remain distinct from final cached qualification.
limits: Public Rust heartbeat with selected independent scripted GROUP peers and actual Apache builders, error factories and parsers. No Java Streams execution engine, live coordinator, membership persistence or failover qualification.
Opt-in is a conservative Rust policy for API88 v0. The version cannot identify release stability; all three actual default builders accepted explicit build0. No false builder-refusal claim.

Wire/decode limits apply to heartbeat bodies; FindCoordinator bodies have a64KiB operation cap. ApiVersions and TLS/SASL use unchanged shared transport/control limits. No allocator-peak or RSS bound qualification.
Successful calls cache one coordinator socket; cancellation/error discard operation-owned sockets. Close does not leave membership. Lost replies/cancellation can follow accepted broker mutations.
The review branch publishes exact tested source. Large execution archives remain locally retained; no main merge, release, hosted CI result, production-readiness or speed ranking.
Conformance implementation classification is updated for API88 and API66v2. Independently qualified required case count remains45/182; core/full completion remain false.
